description: Implementation of the uci_indication_selector class for handling UCI indication PDUs, managing timeouts, and scheduling UCI-related actions in a scheduler component.

classes.name: uci_indication_selector
classes.description: Class responsible for selecting and managing UCI indications, handling timeouts, and scheduling UCI actions.

methods.name: create_action
methods.description: Converts a UCI PDU into a UCI action based on its content.

methods.name: has_harq_ack_bits
methods.description: Checks if a UCI PDU contains HARQ acknowledgment bits.

methods.name: handle_uci_ind_pdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming UCI indication PDU, updating internal state and scheduling actions.

methods.name: handle_uci_pdu
methods.description: Handles a specific UCI PDU and updates the corresponding UCI entry, possibly returning an action.

methods.name: handle_timeouts
methods.description: Manages UCI timeouts, including forced NACKs and cleanup after timeout expiration.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Processes scheduling results, updating UCI grants and handling timeouts.

methods.name: handle_discarded_ucis
methods.description: Handles UCI entries that are discarded, forcing timeouts and cleaning up.
